name: Borja Giménez Larraz - Après le § 41 - Am 48
title: REPORT on the housing crisis in the European Union with the aim of proposing solutions for decent, sustainable and affordable housing
part_text: 41b. Calls on the Commission and the Member States to make the fight against rental and real estate speculation a priority, including through the establishment of a ‘developer charter’ setting maximum average sale prices within defined areas, the introduction of fair and dissuasive fiscal measures to address excessive multi-ownership, the inclusion of anti-speculative clauses in assisted homeownership schemes to prevent short-term resale and disproportionate capital gains, and the prioritisation of housing access for applicants residing in the relevant municipality;
